refnamediv.refpurpose: Compute the phase delay of a filter.

refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: [phi] = phasedelay(b, a, w) [phi] = phasedelay(sos, w) [phi, f] = phasedelay(..., fs)

listitem.para: Frequency points (vector) at which the phase delay is computed (in radians/sample).
(optional) Sampling frequency (scalar). If provided, the frequency vector `f` is returned in Hz.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The `phasedelay` function computes the phase delay of a filter at specified frequency points. It supports both direct rational form (numerator and denominator coefficients) and second-order section (SOS) form.

- For direct rational form, the phase delay is computed using the numerator and denominator coefficients. - For SOS form, the phase delay is computed for each section and summed to obtain the total phase delay.
